proposed_statement_changes.reason: The current attribution obscures that Lee--Gu allow arbitrary observed response spaces and maintain faithfulness. The narrowed statement preserves the directly proved reduced-assumption binary-response rank result, limits the published Theorem 1 transfer to the faithful intersection, and records the second class as a binary-response subclass of their Theorem 2 class.

proposed.justification: The separately typed comparator records the exact binary assumptions and conclusions without specializing any categorical-domain symbol.
proposed.gap: This is a fidelity and reduction proposition, not a categorical novelty claim; all novel determinant and alignment theorems remain scoped to the declared categorical domain.
proposed.consumer: A unified checker can dispatch binary inputs to the published Lee--Gu certificate and categorical inputs to the local-minor certificate.

proposed_core_edits.reason: The corrected claim uses a new cited source-scope leaf, so its dependency list must be updated atomically with the claim narrowing; the existing statement notes are preserved.
